plain_text:
If you think a teen is experiencing a mental health
crisis, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
is a national, 24/7 hotline that can connect
you with a trained crisis counselor by phone
or online chat. TTY users can contact the
Lifeline via their preferred relay service
or by dialing 711, then 988.

plain_text:
Physical symptoms of stress and anxiety include
headaches, trouble sleeping, digestive issues, or muscle
pain. If left untreated, these symptoms can damage the
body and lead to other mental health issues, including
anxiety disorders.
semantic_text: Physical symptoms of stress and anxiety include headaches, trouble sleeping, digestive issues, or muscle pain. If left untreated, these symptoms can damage the body and lead to other mental health issues, including anxiety disorders.

plain_text:
A mental health professional can diagnose an anxiety
disorder, which may require treatment such as therapy
or medication.
semantic_text: A mental health professional can diagnose an anxiety disorder, which may require treatment such as therapy or medication.

plain_text:
We don't know what causes anxiety disorders, but
risk factors include a family history of the condition or
other mental illness and a person's brain biology and
chemistry. Some physical health conditions such as
thyroid problems or arrhythmia can also lead to anxiety
disorders. Experiencing traumatic events is a risk factor
as well.
semantic_text: We don't know what causes anxiety disorders, but risk factors include a family history of the condition or other mental illness and a person's brain biology and chemistry. Some physical health conditions such as thyroid problems or arrhythmia can also lead to anxiety disorders. Experiencing traumatic events is a risk factor as well.

plain_text:
For adolescents, stress and anxiety can be hard to
talk about. Some signs that a teen is struggling may
include noticeable changes in appetite and sleep,
semantic_text: For adolescents, stress and anxiety can be hard to talk about. Some signs that a teen is struggling may include noticeable changes in appetite and sleep,

plain_text:
A teen's environment can contribute to them
developing an anxiety disorder, so in addition to
exploring treatment options, it's important to take
simple steps to decrease their risk.
semantic_text: A teen's environment can contribute to them developing an anxiety disorder, so in addition to exploring treatment options, it's important to take simple steps to decrease their risk.

plain_text:
Sleep. Make sure they are getting enough!


Eight to 10 hours of sleep per night are
recommended for teens ages 13 to 18.


Stick to a regular bedtime and make their
sleep space as calm as possible.

plain_text:
Physical activity. This can be gentle,
such as yoga or walking, or more intense,
like running or playing team sports. Exercise
causes the body to release endorphins,
which are hormones that can relieve pain
and reduce symptoms of anxiety. It also
helps take their mind off whatever is
causing them stress.
semantic_text: Physical activity. This can be gentle, such as yoga or walking, or more intense, like running or playing team sports. Exercise causes the body to release endorphins, which are hormones that can relieve pain and reduce symptoms of anxiety. It also helps take their mind off whatever is causing them stress.

plain_text:
Balanced diet and hydration. Eating
regular, healthy meals and drinking plenty
of water can improve energy and focus
throughout the day. They may want to limit
caffeinated beverages such as soft drinks
or coffee and other foods that can cause
physical symptoms of stress or discomfort.
semantic_text: Balanced diet and hydration. Eating regular, healthy meals and drinking plenty of water can improve energy and focus throughout the day. They may want to limit caffeinated beverages such as soft drinks or coffee and other foods that can cause physical symptoms of stress or discomfort.

plain_text:
Meditation and breathing exercises.
These don't have to be complicated or take
a lot of time. They can spend a few minutes
being still and quiet, listening to their
breathing, and letting their mind clear.
They can also download a mobile app
or listen to meditation playlists to guide
them in a relaxation exercise.

They can spend a few minutes being still and quiet, listening to their breathing, and letting their mind clear. They can also download a mobile app or listen to meditation playlists to guide them in a relaxation exercise.
